settings.title: Carbon wheels, lower price
settings.text: On the SP's electronic builds (Rival AXS and up), carbon wheels come standard. Comparable X-PR builds ship aluminum, with carbon as a paid upgrade — so the SP can cost less and still roll on carbon.

settings.heading: Why pay more for aluminum wheels?
settings.subheading: The SP's Rival, Force, and RED builds ship carbon wheels standard — the X-PR ships aluminum and charges extra for carbon. And the SP still costs less: $3,115 vs $4,499 at the entry tier. Direct-to-consumer, no dealer markup. Verify every figure below.
settings.table_note: X-PR prices are manufacturer MSRP and were verified 2026-06-08; confirm current pricing on quintanarootri.com before each campaign. A2 SP prices are current direct prices. Rows above the divider match the same groupset on both bikes; the “entry electronic shifting” row compares the closest electronic-shifting builds across brands (SRAM Rival AXS vs Shimano 105 Di2), which are different groupsets at a similar tier. Wheels: the SP ships carbon wheels standard on its Rival, Force, and RED builds (the 105 build ships aluminum); the X-PR ships an aluminum Vision Team 30 wheelset standard on every build, with carbon available as a paid upgrade. Rows marked “not offered” have no equivalent build.
settings.financing_price_label: As low as a low monthly payment with Affirm — on the $3,115 Shimano 105 SP.
